title: CivilCADBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Understanding, Reconstructing, and Designing Civil Engineering Drawing Sets
abstract: arXiv:2611.28853v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Civil infrastructure is designed, built, and maintained through engineering drawing sets, yet preparing and revising them remains labour-intensive and calls for automation. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are promising candidates, but assessing them requires a benchmark grounded in real engineering practice. We introduce CivilCADBench, a benchmark for understanding, reconstructing, and designing civil engineering drawing sets, built from real infrastructure drawings and source CAD files containing over 250,000 CAD entities. translated_title: CivilCADBench：面向土木工程图纸集理解、重建与设计的多模态大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 民用基础设施是通过工程图纸集进行设计、建造和维护的，然而图纸的编制与修订仍然是一项劳动密集型工作，亟需自动化手段。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）是很有前景的候选方案，但要对其进行评估，需要一个立足于真实工程实践的基准。我们提出了CivilCADBench，一个用于理解、重建和设计土木工程图纸集的基准，它基于真实的基础设施图纸和源CAD文件构建，其中包含超过25万个CAD实体。与参数化3D CAD模型不同，这些图纸内容密集、分层组织且包含多张图纸；由于打印件是有损投影、图层信息不会以像素形式保留，一个文件可能打印正确，但其内部组织结构却是错误的。CivilCADBench包含三个难度递增的任务族：理解任务通过2,183道经专家审核的问题进行评估，这些问题涵盖从单张图纸到整套图纸；而重建任务……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了基于包含25万余个CAD实体的真实基础设施图纸构建的CivilCADBench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在土木工程图纸集的理解、重建与设计能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces CivilCADBench, a benchmark built from real infrastructure drawings and source CAD files containing over 250,000 CAD entities, for evaluating multimodal LLMs on understanding, reconstructing, and designing civil engineering drawing sets.
